text:
maria: onboarding a Dedicated customer and running into an SSL handshake when going through their corporate proxy + custom CA. local sample app fine, k8s fails. using python async SDK (aiohttp under the hood). error: SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED

aj: are you setting REDWOOD_BASE_URL or passing base_url? also what envs/proxy settings are present?

maria: passing base_url directly. snippet:
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
async def main():
    c = AsyncClient(base_url="https://dedicated.example.com", api_key="redacted", proxy="http://10.0.0.1:3128", ca_bundle="/etc/pki/redwood-ca.pem")
    await c.generate("hello")
```
fails at TLS handshake. tried HTTPS_PROXY and SSL_CERT_FILE but same result.

samir: common root causes: 1) aiohttp connector won't read REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE/SSL_CERT_FILE automatically unless you pass an ssl.SSLContext 2) intercepting proxy might replace certs so client must trust proxy CA.

maria: how to construct ssl.SSLContext for this?

samir: e.g.
```python
import ssl
from redwood import AsyncClient
ssl_ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile='/etc/pki/redwood-ca.pem')
client = AsyncClient(base_url='https://dedicated.example.com', api_key='...', connector_args={'ssl': ssl_ctx, 'force_close': True})
```
Note: sdk currently exposes connector_args to pass down to aiohttp but it's poorly typed and undocumented. we should add an explicit truststore_path parameter.

olivia: agreed — typing is an issue. mypy complains because connector_args is typed as Mapping[str, str] in some places. we should change to Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] or add a dedicated param.

aj: also flagging an auth-retry quirk: if token refresh request goes through proxy without the ssl context, we saw 401s then a tight retry loop. check logs for repeated refresh errors.

maria: saw repeated 401s right after the cert error. after applying ssl_ctx the handshake error stopped, but then token refresh hit a 502 from the proxy.

samir: 502 on CONNECT often means proxy can't reach upstream or dislikes CONNECT details. try forcing HTTP/1.1 on the connector (some proxies choke on h2) and ensure SNI header is correct.

maria: forcing http1 + ssl_ctx fixed end-to-end for generation calls. but mypy errors remain when constructing AsyncClient with connector_args. also our public sample Dockerfile doesn't show adding the custom CA into OS truststore which confuses customers.

olivia: proposed DX changes:
- add typed param truststore_path: Optional[str] to AsyncClient constructor (and for sync client too)
- make async path honor SSL_CERT_FILE / REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE by default if connector_args['ssl'] not provided
- document OS CA install steps (Debian: update-ca-certificates, Alpine: update-ca-certificates, or copy to /usr/local/share/ca-certificates) with sample k8s initContainer
- ensure token refresh/retry reuses the same ssl context when proxy is used

aj: i'll open a GH issue with labels py-sdk, devex, security, customer-onboarding. maria, can you attach a redacted repro and a few log lines?

maria: redacted logs:
```
2026-03-18T14:02:10Z maria kube-proxy: CONNECT dedicated.example.com:443 failed: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed (_ssl.c:997)
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z maria auth: token refresh failed 401 via proxy
```
aj: thanks — creating issue and adding suggested typing patch.

devx-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/4723 1add: "py-sdk: truststore_path param + ensure ssl context reuse on refresh retries" (assign: aj) :sparkles:

maria: one more note: customers expect a single env var flow (REDWOOD_BASE_URL + HTTPS_PROXY + SSL_CERT_FILE). if async client automatically falls back to SSL_CERT_FILE that would remove a lot of friction.

samir: i'll PR the aiohttp connector helper to read SSL_CERT_FILE and create ssl.SSLContext when connector_args['ssl'] is absent. will also add a small example in examples/onprem demonstrating mounting the CA and running an initContainer to update the truststore.

olivia: i'll follow up with a mypy-friendly typing PR: connector_args: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] + explicit truststore_path param.

maria: thanks everyone — workaround is ssl ctx + force http1. keeping customer updated and linked internal onboarding doc at docs/onboarding/dedicated-proxy.md. :thumbsup:
